nmd_code_labels.52: 52 Exploaterad mark, ej byggnad eller väg/järnväg

meta.notes: species_class and is_forest derived from Naturvardsverket Nationella Marktackedata (NMD) 2018 basskikt land-cover raster, sampled by WMS GetFeatureInfo at each grid cell CENTER (single 10 m pixel per cell; not a majority vote). nmd_code = raw NMD basskikt class code. is_forest=1 for standing forest classes (species 1-4,6); clearcut/regenerating 'Temporart ej skog' is species_class=5 with is_forest=0 (forest land use but currently treeless). VOLUME/basal-area was NOT obtained: the Skogsstyrelsen Skogliga grunddata ImageServer now requires HTTP Basic auth (401). Tree HEIGHT was instead sourced from NMD Objekthojd (see below). Null = NMD returned no value / outside coverage. || TREE HEIGHT ADDED: from NMD Objekthojd 5-45 m (tall-object height). Encoding: pixel value = upper edge of a 5 m height bin in METRES (10='5-10 m', 15='10-15 m', ... 45='40-45 m'); nodata=255 also means 'no >=5 m object present' (open land, clearcut, water, alpine all read as nodata). tree_height = value of the single 10 m pixel at each cell CENTER (null where no >=5 m object). tree_height_mean_m = MEAN of tall-object pixel heights over ALL 10 m pixels in the cell (null if the cell has no >=5 m objects) - more robust maturity proxy than the center pixel. tall_cover_frac = fraction (0..1) of the cell's 10 m pixels carrying a >=5 m object = canopy/maturity density. Heights are 5 m-quantized; subtract ~2.5 m for bin midpoints if needed.
